## Project Primary Configuration Files (JSON)
Each project in the Prismata workspace contains a standard primary config file defining the project metadata, workspace root mode and primary workspace paths.

The Primary config file will be placed in each respective projects /config folder within the project root /{$PROJECT_NAME}/config/

The config file will be named based on the project name, in matched casing, and with the appended suffix "_CONFIG.json"

Primary Config file: {$PROJECT_NAME}_CONFIG.json
